6.322 rsReportItemReferenceInPageSection
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsReportItemReferenceInPageSection is a critical error that occurs when an expression in a
PageSection element contains a reference to a report item via the ReportItems global collection that
does not exist in the current ReportSection.
